scripts.dev: npm run maps && node scripts/check-content.mjs && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.check: node scripts/check-content.mjs && node scripts/generate-mindmaps.mjs --check && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check
scripts.build: npm run maps && npm run check && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && pagefind --site dist && node scripts/check-dist.mjs && node scripts/manifest.mjs
